architectural_notes: Webhook URL will be embedded in frontend code instead of read from environment variables (deployment no longer depends on VITE_WEBHOOK_URL).

existing_features.title: Hard-code the ActivePieces webhook endpoint URL in the frontend code so the app works without configuring the VITE_WEBHOOK_URL environment variable. Use this exact URL: https://cloud.activepieces.com/api/v1/webhooks/arB5MIDx32mR1vdmBIC0r/sync

Remove/disable any UI warnings, prompts, or help panels that instruct the user to configure VITE_WEBHOOK_URL (e.g., messages like “Webhook URL is not configured...”). The dashboard should not display any webhook setup banner in live mode.

Ensure file upload and Ask AI flows no longer fail with an error that specifically references missing VITE_WEBHOOK_URL. Error messages (when they occur) should reflect actual network/response failures, not configuration instructions.

new_feature_requests.summary: Hard-code webhook URL in frontend code (avoid needing VITE_WEBHOOK_URL environment variable)
